summary: Tested year filter functionality and routing for CRM pages. Backend filtering works correctly (898→504→17 opps for no filter→2025→2026). Frontend year filter works on Dashboard but filters don't persist across page navigation due to sidebar links not preserving URL query parameters.

critical_bugs.issue: Filter state not persisted when navigating between pages - URL query parameters are lost
critical_bugs.description: When user selects year=2025 on Dashboard (URL: /dashboard?year=2025) and clicks 'Opportunities' link, the URL changes to /opportunities without query params. The GlobalFilterContext syncs filters to URL, but sidebar Link components don't preserve existing query params when navigating.
affected_pages: All CRM pages - Dashboard, Opportunities, Accounts, Activities, Analytics, Timeline, Invoices
critical_bugs.root_cause: Sidebar.js NavItem component uses plain <Link to={item.href}> without preserving search params
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Modify NavItem component to use useSearchParams() and append current query string to navigation links: <Link to={`${item.href}${location.search}`}>

✅ Backend API - Dashboard stats with year=2025 filter (504 opportunities)

✅ Backend API - Accounts list with year=2025 filter
✅ Backend API - Activities list with year=2025 filter

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX REQUIRED: Modify Sidebar.js NavItem component to preserve URL query parameters when navigating. Change line 157 from `to={item.href}` to `to={item.href + location.search}` or use `to={{ pathname: item.href, search: location.search }}`. This will ensure filters persist across page navigation. All backend filtering is working correctly - this is purely a frontend navigation issue.

success_percentage.frontend: 60% (6/10 tests passed - filter works but doesn't persist, routing tests couldn't complete due to navigation issue)
